visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Every Row Starts at 1
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Floyd's triangle should print 1, then 2 3, then 4 5 6, but every row restarts at 1.

solution.explanation: A variable declared inside the outer loop is created again for every row, so it restarts at 1. To keep counting across rows it must be declared before the loops.
